# Python MCP server for the bilibili tools (bili_search / bili_subtitle / bili_comments / ...).
# Base is AGI_Ananas/bilibili-mcp, MIT. Only these deps are needed.
#
# Keep this file ASCII-only: pip reads a requirements file with the platform
# locale encoding on Windows (GBK / CP936), so non-ASCII comments make
# `pip install -r` die with UnicodeDecodeError. That is why the notes below are
# in English even though the rest of the repo is Chinese.
bilibili-api-python>=17.4.1,<18
aiohttp>=3.9.0
# Must stay <2: the mcp 2.x server has no list_tools and fails to start.
mcp>=1.0.0,<2
# bili_login / bili_login_check draw the QR code locally.
qrcode[pil]>=8.0
# bili_frames cuts frames; Pillow is enough (also pulled in by qrcode[pil]).
Pillow>=9.0
